source: Mostly https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gcc/C-Extensions.html, from pages with 'Builtins' in their title

notes.compiler: When present, indicates this builtin is only available in Frama-C machdeps with this compiler. Allowed values: gcc, msvc, !msvc (the latter meaning: 'available in machdeps with compilers other than MSVC').
notes.rettype: Return type of the builtin. Whitespace is important: types are matched as exact strings, with a single space between components.
notes.args: List of the types of the builtin arguments. Whitespace is important: types are matched as exact strings, with a single space between components.
notes.types: When present, a list indicating that this is a builtin template, to be instantiated for each type in the list. Instantiation is the replacement of each occurrence of 'type' in 'rettype' and 'args' with the elements of this list.
notes.variadic: Whether this builtin behaves as a variadic function.
